title: Dark settings modal: menu column plus profile form with accent-outlined active item

observed.layout: Settings modal on a tiled dark background. Left column: Edit profile (active, blue outline), Change password, Notification, Security, Saved address, Saved payment, Language (value 'English'), Dark mode (toggle on), and 'Sign Out' in orange-red below a divider. Right: gradient cover with an overlapping round avatar and an 'Upload new image' chip, helper text about size and formats, fields labeled Name (placeholder 'Username or email'), Location, Bio, and two buttons: outlined 'Discard' and blue-gradient 'Save changes'.
observed.hierarchy: Save changes (filled gradient) over Discard (outline); the blue outline marks the active menu item.
observed.typography: Geometric sans; small sizes, light grey.
observed.iconography: Outline icons beside menu items and inside fields.
observed.materials: Dark glassy inputs with subtle gradients and highlights; blue glow on active/primary.

interpretation.aesthetic: Dark settings UI with neon-blue accent and a warm gradient cover as the only warm area.
implementation_notes: Active item: accent border with soft outer glow.
Inputs: subtle vertical gradient fill with inner highlight.

concept_work.essence: A familiar settings layout made premium through dark glass surfaces and a single accent.
what_makes_it_work: Primary versus secondary buttons are distinct.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Name field shows placeholder 'Username or email', which contradicts its label.
Inactive menu text about 2.8-3.1:1; Sign Out about 2.9-3.3:1; helper text about 2.7-3.1:1.
Sign Out styled as a warning although it is not destructive.

pattern.name: Settings split view (menu plus form) with accent-outlined active item
avoid_when: Very small screens without a stacked alternative
adaptation_examples: Mobile: the menu becomes a list screen that pushes to the form.
Light theme: replace glows with borders and subtle shadows.

lessons: Placeholders must match their field's meaning and never replace labels.
Reserve warning colors for destructive actions.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
palette: muted warm tone in the cover blend
measured.color_roles: Near-black surfaces; blue = active/primary; warm gradient only in the cover image; orange-red also used for Sign Out.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: Account settings with an obvious route to edit and save.
Dark glass surfaces and a gradient cover give depth without noise.
Form structure is standard, but the Name label/placeholder mismatch and the warning-colored Sign Out reduce correctness.
Primary/secondary actions clear; error, validation and focus states are not shown.
Consistent radii, icon weight and field styling.
Visual treatment is polished but the pattern is conventional.

Scored on conservative values: primary text min 2.75:1; secondary text min 2.74:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True. Using best-estimate values the score would be 2; the measurement is within error of a threshold.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

cf1_watchlist: Inactive "Saved address": 2.75-3.09:1 (conservative value below 3, best estimate above)
Sign Out: 2.85-3.27:1 (conservative value below 3, best estimate above)
evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
